name: Popup (deprecated)
summary: Deprecated G4 identity retained only as a pre-v1 migration record to canonical B9 Popover; it owns no overlay, modal semantics, CSS, renderer, fixture, behavior or target adapter.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Canonical non-modal floating panel owned by B9 Popover.

anatomy.name: arrow
anatomy.description: Optional decorative arrow pointing toward the trigger.

anatomy.name: title
anatomy.description: Optional contextual title inside canonical Popover.

anatomy.name: content
anatomy.description: Concise arbitrary Popover content, including a small target-composed control group.

variants.name: default
variants.description: Canonical Popover surface; former Split and Slide popup variants are removed.

states.name: open
states.description: Visible canonical portable or native Web state.

behavior.name: visibility
behavior.description: The canonical panel is hidden by default and visible only in the portable or native open state.

behavior.name: triggerRelationship
behavior.description: A native Button owns the accessible name, expanded state and stable panel relationship; the trigger is also the default visual anchor.

behavior.name: contentSemantics
behavior.description: Popover has no default ARIA role. Semantics derive from actual content; the deprecated Popup identity does not reintroduce dialog or modal semantics.

behavior.name: dismissal
behavior.description: Repeated trigger activation, Escape and outside interaction close the transient surface.

behavior.name: focusManagement
behavior.description: The non-modal surface preserves natural Tab order, never traps focus or inerts the page, and restores trigger focus after keyboard dismissal when focus moved inside.

behavior.name: stateOwnership
behavior.description: Targets may control open state or provide an uncontrolled default while preserving canonical Popover meaning.

properties.name: open
properties.description: Canonical Popover visibility; content and trigger are composition, while positioning, collision and focus details remain target services.

accessibility: Use canonical Popover for concise non-modal supplemental content anchored to an explicit native Button trigger.
Connect trigger and panel with aria-controls/aria-expanded or native popovertarget behavior.
Do not add aria-modal, a backdrop, focus trap, scroll lock or default role=dialog.
Close on Escape, outside interaction and repeated trigger activation without blocking page interaction.
Preserve natural Tab order and restore trigger focus after keyboard dismissal when focus moved inside.
Use canonical Modal for page-blocking marketing campaigns and Dropdown Menu for menu semantics.

web.notes: Temporary migration records render canonical B9 Popover source and target-owned anchored lifecycle; G4 owns no independent Web output.

shopify.notes: Compose canonical Popover or Modal according to campaign semantics; G4 owns no Shopify adapter.
